purpose: Maintained post-research refinements; original research provenance remains separate. Apply only the branches selected by the task.
basis: Kings and Pigs pilot three, 16 October 2026: retained raw failures and independent source-first review
Godot 4.7 official TileMapPattern class reference, checked 16 October 2026

pitfalls_append: An atlas cell can be valid yet contain only part of a motif or an unintended transparent region. Identify complete composite footprints and intended top/side/bottom caps from the actual artwork.
In Godot 4.7, `TileMapPattern.set_cell` defaults `alternative_tile` to -1. Supply the intended valid alternative explicitly (often 0); preserve deliberate erase cells as an explicit pattern choice.
verification_append: For a repeated motif, stamp a representative complete pattern, save/reopen and inspect its entire footprint at game scale, including edge/corner/isolated caps. Confirm intended painted cells are nonempty and reference valid source/atlas/alternative IDs; a loop over zero cells proves nothing.

Keep fixed actors/pickups named and selectable. Check their relevant visual/collision footprint against solids and declared decoration exclusions across the authored set where practical. Record intentional hidden rewards, cropping, overlap or procedural exceptions.

sources_append.title: `TileMapPattern.set_cell` (Godot 4.7)
sources_append.limits: Version-specific defaults; a valid alternative alone does not establish complete artwork or intended paint output.

verification_append: When authored art needs closed edges or complete composites, include open-neighbor and underside cases plus the intended motif anchors. Check both required placements and forbidden overlaps; preserve deliberate open/broken art. For native pattern stamping and valid alternatives, see [grid worlds](D2-01.md).

Inspect the actual opaque artwork and transparent margins before choosing atlas regions or sprite pivots. Check complete motifs and body alignment in both facings at game scale; nearest filtering alone does not establish correct slicing or placement.

pitfalls_append: Starting a completed one-shot again from a per-frame loop can rewind a pose even when a completion signal fires only once. Give the start, completion and recovery transition an explicit owner.
verification_append: When replay or strike timing matters, record ordered frame/state changes through completion and recovery, not just a completion count. For example, intended `0,1,2` must reject an unrequested `0,1,2,0` rewind; explicit combos, cancellations and loops retain their own contract. Include affected hit/death interruptions and restart. Label each sample with its animation/state so recovery to idle frame 0 is not mistaken for attack replay.

For designed grace, buffering or cooldown, test accepted and expired boundaries, one-time consumption and reset at declared physics timing; observe feel separately. Window lengths and the presence of coyote time are game choices. Distinguish the movement body from the sensor roles in [overlap filtering](D2-09.md).

D2-09.approach_append: Declare the purpose of movement, incoming hurt/strike, outgoing strike and pickup geometry separately. Choose their margins from the game contract: forgiving beneficial interactions and strict incoming damage are one valid design; precision or symmetric games can choose differently.
verification_append: For a strike-filtering negative, prove the attacker reached its active strike frames while the target remained outside the intended shape. A target outside AI activation distance only tests activation. Pair contact with relevant horizontal/vertical/facing near misses, mask exclusions and repeat-hit guards.

For changed pickup or outgoing reach, check a chosen nearby success and a distant/behind rejection as appropriate. Display the actual native shapes over both-facing artwork; fixed pixel sizes and a shared global generosity multiplier are not universal.

Declare intended actor, interactable, decoration, feedback and HUD relationships. Check inherited/relative Z, Y-sort and canvas boundaries, then observe a representative actual overlap such as player with flag/door or foreground art. Preserve deliberate occlusion and isometric depth; player priority over all artwork is not universal.

verification: For changed keyboard bindings, test fixed expected device events through InputEventKey → the saved InputMap → observable scene behavior. Set physical_keycode for physical bindings or keycode for logical bindings. Inject press/release events with Input.parse_input_event, allow relevant process/physics frames, and assert the resulting interaction. Keep expected keys independent of InputMap.action_get_events() so reversed or missing mappings fail. Release every injected key and restore input/focus state.
Action-level tests (Input.action_press or InputEventAction) exercise downstream logic but bypass device bindings; pair them with the physical-event path when bindings are in scope.
Keep visible interaction on each nominated real device/platform for window focus, layout, delivery and controller behavior. Injected events establish engine routing, not OS or hardware delivery.
Remap and restart to check settings persistence.
Confirm UI focus actions remain distinct.

sources_append.title: Input.parse_input_event
sources_append.limits: Injects events into Godot; does not send events to the operating system.

sources_append.title: InputEventKey.physical_keycode
sources_append.limits: Physical positions and logical keycodes have distinct layout semantics; match the chosen binding model.
